text:
Omar (AE): Heads up  — NovaLedger wants an exec bridge. CTO + Head of Infra are pressing on two blockers before they sign the pilot: (A) BYO KMS with HSM attestation, (B) a one-quarter temporary pricing floor below published tiers. They want answers today.

Tess (SE): Reproduced the KMS access error in our sandbox. Their key policy denies our service principal from GenerateDataKey. Fast path: they add our service principal ARN to the key policy for the pilot. If not possible, we can host the keys in a customer-dedicated cluster and restrict egress.

Diego (Ops): We can spin up a dedicated cluster (nova-ded-7) with strict egress and no shared caches. ETA ~25m after we get role ARN + CIDRs. Will post allowlist template.

Carmen (CISO): For BYO KMS we require: HSM attestation (or vendor attestation PDF), key policy snapshot, export access to audit logs for the pilot window, and confirmation of admin SSO + MFA. For pilot we can accept a signed attestation from their infra lead plus timeframe-bound log exports.

Hana (Legal): They asked for a light NDA variant to run the pilot. Legal can fast-track a 6-week pilot NDA if security signs off — that'll avoid full contract delays.

Priya (CS): Proposed customer-facing plan: 1) pre-bridge tech sync (30m), 2) exec bridge with CTO/CFO, 3) pilot run under pilot-NDA + scoped attestation, 4) ops handoff. I'll draft and share.

finance-bot: Pricing guidance: reps may approve up to 12% concession for pilots under 3 months. Anything >12% or structural change to published floor requires VP Finance sign-off. Provide ARR forecast for escalation.

Tess (SE): Policy snippet to send (replace CUSTOMER_ROLE_ARN):

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "CUSTOMER_ROLE_ARN"},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:ReEncrypt*"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

Diego (Ops): IP allowlist template: 198.51.100.0/24. Send CIDRs and role ARN and we'll provision nova-ded-7.

Omar (AE): Can we offer trial credits + a 10% temporary concession instead of changing published floor? That should be within finance guidance.

finance-bot: Confirmed: 10% + trial credits OK. Document expected ARR and convert probability in the bridge pre-read.

Carmen (CISO): I'll prepare the minimal attestation checklist and security talking points. If they can provide HSM vendor attestation and a key rotation schedule, security can greenlight pilot under pilot-NDA.

Hana (Legal): I'll draft the 6-week pilot NDA and circulate for quick review.

Tess (SE): I'll set up a debug session with their infra lead in 20m to validate the policy and reproduce the path.

deploy-bot: Provision event — dedicated-cluster nova-ded-7 queued at 3234567980.

Priya (CS): Pre-sync at 14:00 PT, exec bridge 14:30 PT. Owners: Tess (tech), Diego (ops), Carmen (security), Hana (legal), Omar (sales), Priya (cs).

Omar (AE): Nova infra lead says they'll send role ARN + CIDRs within 45m. I'll update thread when received.

Tess (SE): I'll paste verification steps into the runbook after the pre-sync.

Diego (Ops): Once we have CIDRs/ARN I'll flip nova-ded-7 to active and post SSH+monitoring endpoints for the handoff.

Carmen (CISO): Note: if HSM attestation is delayed, security can accept an interim signed attestation + a log export schedule for the pilot only.

Omar (AE): Thanks team. I'll share the calendar invite and attach pre-read (include the finance-bot note).
